title: Canon Forge
valueStatement: Stateful generative-AI architecture that maintains characters, sets, and shot consistency across image and video production.
architectureHighlight: Converts creative intent into explicit reference, composition, and keyframe contracts for reliable generative output.
description: A character-reference architect for generative production: lock a person, a set, and a shot grammar so Gemini image models stay inside canon instead of reinventing the face, wardrobe, and room on every frame.
pitch: Stateful generative-AI architecture that maintains characters, sets, and shot consistency across image and video production.
challenge: Image models drift. A headshot, a wardrobe turn, a library interior, and a medium shot of the same figure holding a prop will not stay one canon unless the product treats identity, set, and camera as locked assets — not a prompt you hope the model remembers.
development: Built a TypeScript/React/Vite production suite (CharacterForge, SetForge, CompositorForge, SceneForge) on Gemini image models. Characters carry approved canon headshots and wardrobe; sets carry spatial invariants, landmarks, forbidden changes, and lighting lock; compositing specifies shot type, lens, angle, and landmark lock before a frame is allowed to generate.
outcome: A working character-reference architect (Gemini-backed). Interactive demo is a Vite app with a server-side key — not this static portfolio. Source: github.com/rubyrayjuntos/canon-forge.

journey.title: Stop asking the model to remember the person
journey.description: Treated identity as an approved asset, not a paragraph in the prompt. The canon headshot is the source of truth the later shots have to match.

journey.title: Lock the room the same way
journey.description: Sets got the same treatment: wide/medium canon, landmarks that cannot move, lighting that cannot reinvent itself between takes.

journey.title: Compose, then generate
journey.description: CompositorForge only fires after character, set, action, lens, and landmark lock are specified. The model is a renderer inside a shot list.

journey.title: Four forges, one production grammar
journey.description: Character, Set, Compositor, and Scene tabs share one profile model so a later frame cannot quietly become a different actor in a different room.

specs.title: Canon headshot as identity kernel
specs.description: Approved reference images (head, body, wardrobe, expression) are stored on the character profile. Later generations are constrained to that asset, not to a vibes prompt.

specs.title: Set invariants and lighting lock
specs.description: Indoor/outdoor sets declare spatial invariants, fixed landmarks, forbidden changes, and a lighting-rig lock so the environment does not mutate between shots.

specs.title: Shot grammar before pixels
specs.description: Compositor specs encode shot type, camera angle, lens preset, subject distance, emotion, and landmark lock — the same language a DP would put on a shot list.

specs.title: Gemini as renderer, not director
specs.description: The model produces frames inside the locked profiles. It does not own canon. Failed or off-model frames stay out of the approved sheet.

specs.title: Vite production app, not a slideshow
specs.description: React 19 + Vite 6 + TypeScript. Needs a server-side Gemini key. This static portfolio cannot host it; GitHub Pages or Render can after a proper build.
